## 读取

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

input_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Projects/scRhythmBayes_simulation/output/scRITMO_extended_simulation/sigma_gradient_1p5_2p5_3p5_4p5_5p5_6p5_empirical_fixed_v1/R_input"
src <- file.path(input_dir, "phase_uncertainty")
out <- path.expand("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/R/c2g")
dir.create(file.path(out, "data"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out, "fig"), showWarnings = FALSE)

post <- readRDS(file.path(src, "phase_Q.rds"))
meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "metadata.csv"))
meta <- meta[match(post$phase$cell, meta$cell), ]
stopifnot(identical(post$phase$cell, meta$cell))

truth <- read.csv(file.path(dirname(input_dir), "gene_truth.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(tolower(is_seed) != "true", !gene_id %in% post$seed) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene = gene_id, celltype,
                   Rhythmic = tolower(true_rhythmic) == "true", true_phase_rad)
```

## 相位覆盖率

```{r}
Q <- post$Q
step <- 2*pi / ncol(Q)
bin <- floor((meta$Theta_true %% (2*pi)) / step + 0.5) %% ncol(Q) + 1L
q_true <- Q[cbind(seq_len(nrow(Q)), bin)]
qs <- t(apply(Q, 1, sort, decreasing = TRUE))
cq <- t(apply(qs, 1, cumsum))
cov <- data.frame()

for (level in c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95)) {
  j <- max.col(cq >= level, ties.method = "first")
  threshold <- qs[cbind(seq_len(nrow(Q)), j)]
  region <- Q >= threshold - 1e-14
  cov <- dplyr::bind_rows(cov, data.frame(
    cell = meta$cell, celltype = meta$celltype, Nominal = level,
    Covered = q_true >= threshold - 1e-14,
    Mass = rowSums(Q * region)
  ))
}

cov_res <- cov %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, Nominal) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Cells = dplyr::n(), Coverage = mean(Covered),
                   Mass = mean(Mass), Gap = Coverage - Mass, .groups = "drop")

write.csv(cov, file.path(out, "data/cov_cell.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cov_res, file.path(out, "data/cov.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cov_res
```

## 固定相位

```{r}
fixed <- readRDS(file.path(src, "fixed.rds"))$param_long %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(truth, by = c("gene", "celltype"))

base <- fixed %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Fixed_calls = sum(is.finite(FDR) & FDR < 0.05),
    Phase_MAE = mean(abs(atan2(sin(Phase[Rhythmic] - true_phase_rad[Rhythmic]),
                                 cos(Phase[Rhythmic] - true_phase_rad[Rhythmic]))) * 24/(2*pi),
                     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(base, file.path(out, "data/fixed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
base
```

## 五次抽样

```{r}
draw_est <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  "1" = readRDS(file.path(src, "draw_1.rds"))$param_long,
  "2" = readRDS(file.path(src, "draw_2.rds"))$param_long,
  "3" = readRDS(file.path(src, "draw_3.rds"))$param_long,
  "4" = readRDS(file.path(src, "draw_4.rds"))$param_long,
  "5" = readRDS(file.path(src, "draw_5.rds"))$param_long,
  .id = "Draw"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Draw = as.integer(Draw))

draw <- tidyr::crossing(fixed, Draw = 1:5) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(draw_est, by = c("gene", "celltype", "Draw"),
                   suffix = c("_fixed", "_draw")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Fixed_valid = is.finite(FDR_fixed),
    Draw_valid = is.finite(FDR_draw),
    Call_draw = is.finite(FDR_draw) & FDR_draw < 0.05,
    Call_fixed = is.finite(FDR_fixed) & FDR_fixed < 0.05,
    Error = abs(atan2(sin(Phase_draw - true_phase_rad),
                      cos(Phase_draw - true_phase_rad))) * 24/(2*pi),
    Change = abs(atan2(sin(Phase_draw - Phase_fixed),
                       cos(Phase_draw - Phase_fixed))) * 24/(2*pi)
  )

res <- draw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Draw, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Phase_MAE = mean(Error[Rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    Kept = sum(Call_fixed & Call_draw),
    Lost = sum(Call_fixed & Draw_valid & !Call_draw),
    Missing = sum(Call_fixed & !Draw_valid),
    Gained = sum(Fixed_valid & !Call_fixed & Call_draw),
    Missing_draw = sum(!Draw_valid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(base, celltype, Fixed_calls), by = "celltype") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Retention = Kept / Fixed_calls)

stopifnot(all(res$Kept + res$Lost + res$Missing == res$Fixed_calls))

shift <- draw %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rhythmic) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Change = mean(Change, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(draw, file.path(out, "data/draw_gene.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res, file.path(out, "data/draw.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(shift, file.path(out, "data/shift.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
res
```

## 阳性基因

```{r}
genes <- draw %>%
  dplyr::filter(Call_fixed) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Fixed_FDR = first(FDR_fixed), Draws = dplyr::n(),
    Retained = sum(Call_draw), Missing = sum(!Draw_valid),
    Frequency = Retained / Draws,
    Phase_change = mean(Change, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bands <- genes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Band = ifelse(Fixed_FDR < 0.01, "<0.01", "0.01-0.05")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, Band) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Genes = dplyr::n(), Retention = mean(Frequency), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(genes, file.path(out, "data/genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bands, file.path(out, "data/bands.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
bands
```

## 作图

```{r, fig.width=8.2677, fig.height=5.8465}
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(10, "pt"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)))

col <- c("CT1" = "#A43B3B", "CT2" = "#BA7C4A", "CT3" = "#9A9651",
         "CT4" = "#558A85", "CT5" = "#6579A5", "CT6" = "#684B7B")

p1 <- ggplot(cov_res, aes(Mass * 100, Coverage * 100, colour = celltype)) +
  annotate("segment", x = 50, xend = 96, y = 50, yend = 96,
           linetype = 2, colour = "#AAAAAA", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 70, 90, 95)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Phase coverage", x = "Probability mass (%)", y = "Coverage (%)")

res$x <- match(res$celltype, c("CT1", "CT6")) + (res$Draw - 3) * 0.06
base$x <- match(base$celltype, c("CT1", "CT6"))

p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = res, aes(x, Phase_MAE, shape = "Draws"), colour = "#A43B3B", size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = base, aes(x, Phase_MAE, shape = "Fixed"), colour = "#202020", size = 2.3) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Fixed" = 17, "Draws" = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = c("CT1", "CT6"), limits = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(title = "Acrophase error", x = "Cell type", y = "MAE (h)")

p3 <- ggplot(res, aes(x, Retention * 100)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = 2, colour = "#AAAAAA", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(colour = "#A43B3B", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = c("CT1", "CT6"), limits = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Call retention", x = "Cell type", y = "Retained (%)")

p4 <- ggplot(shift, aes(celltype, Change)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, colour = "#684B7B", fill = "#DDD4E3",
               linewidth = 0.5, outlier.size = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Gene sensitivity", x = "Cell type", y = "Mean change (h)")

p <- (p1 + p2 + p3 + p4) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal")

p
```
